title: Sliding notes switch, ambient accent background, direction-aware tab motion
changes: Notes mode switch (shared / per tab) is now a segmented control with a single thumb that glides between the two options
Frame background carries the tab accent: richer and darker along the rim, calm in the centre, with soft edge glows that drift slowly
Switching tabs plays a band of accent colour from the chosen tab's side across the frame, and the input and result panels slide in from that side
Direction is derived from the on-screen position of the old and new tab, so it follows tab order, reordering and RTL
All motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
